name: Happy hour promo (portrait)
description: A portrait (9:16) happy hour or daypart offer for a bar or restaurant: a big headline, the days and hours, three deals with prices, a drink picture with a warm glow, and a live clock so guests can see how long is left.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A square-ish PNG or SVG. The bundled badge is a placeholder; replace it with your own.

params.name: show_logo
params.label: Show the logo
params.help: Turn off if you have no logo (an empty logo setting would otherwise show a dashed box).

params.name: brand
params.label: Store name
params.help: Shown beside the logo. Leave empty if your logo already says it.

params.name: headline
params.label: Headline, first line
params.help: The headline is set in two big lines, a word or two each: Happy / Hour, Weekend / Brunch, Late / Bites.

params.name: hours
params.label: When it runs
params.help: Typed as it should read; unlike the clock it is not translated. Schedule the slide in your playlist to show only during these hours.

params.name: deal1_note
params.label: Deal 1 note
params.default: Red, white or rosé by the glass

params.name: deal2_note
params.label: Deal 2 note
params.default: Every tap, including the seasonal sour

params.name: product_image
params.label: Product picture
params.help: A cut-out PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best. It is fitted, never cropped.

params.name: show_image
params.label: Show the product picture
params.help: Turn off to leave the panel without a picture (an empty picture setting would otherwise show a dashed box).

params.name: show_clock
params.label: Show the clock
params.help: A live clock in the top corner, so guests can see how long is left.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Clock timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen’s own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The language of the clock, e.g. en-US or de-DE. Leave empty for the screen’s language.

params.name: clock_format
params.label: Clock format
params.help: 24-hour suits most countries. Pick 12-hour (AM/PM) for the US and other places that use it.

params.name: small_print
params.label: Small print
params.default: Bar and patio only. Please drink responsibly — ID required.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The second headline line, the glow behind the picture and the clock pill.

params.name: highlight
params.label: Price colour
params.help: The deal prices and the hours line.

params.name: background_image
params.label: Background photo
params.help: Optional. A photo behind everything, darkened by the setting below.

params.name: background_dim
params.label: Darken the photo
params.help: 0 = the photo as is, 0.9 = almost black. Only used with a background photo.
